ios-feedback|Feedback.summary: Record workflows communicate saving, saved, offline, failed, draft and archived states through text and a symbol. Private edits can autosave; a failed write retains the latest value and a Retry action. Draft deletion requires confirmation; archiving stays reversible.

variants.name: Autosave
variants.uikit: UILabel and UIImageView expose a combined accessibilityLabel.
variants.appkit: NSTextField and NSImageView expose the state together.
variants.use: Private edits that are safe to persist automatically.

variants.name: Draft state
variants.swiftui: Label("Draft", systemImage: "pencil") with resume and discard actions
variants.uikit: UIButton actions resume or confirm discarding the draft.
variants.appkit: NSButton actions retain the draft on failure.
variants.use: Unfinished work that can be resumed.

variants.name: Archive and restore
variants.swiftui: An archived status Label and Restore button remain above record content.
variants.uikit: UIStackView keeps the archived message and restore action visible.
variants.appkit: NSStackView presents the persistent status and restore action.
variants.use: A reversible transition out of active use.

attributes.appkit: NSStackView.spacing reads plx-sys-space-stack-md from the macOS token adapter.

attributes.uikit: UIFontMetrics scales DM Sans for the body role.
attributes.appkit: NSFont uses DM Sans through the macOS token adapter.

states.name: Saving
states.behavior: Serialize writes; queue the latest edit without changing focus.

states.name: Offline
states.behavior: Keep pending data and retry on reconnect.

states.name: Failed
states.behavior: Announce the failure and expose Retry; never clear the editor.

states.name: Archived
states.behavior: Keep Restore available until it succeeds.

swiftui: // The view model owns serialized persistence, connectivity and durable draft storage.
if model.failed { Button("Retry") { Task { await model.retry() } } }
if model.archived { Button("Restore") { Task { await model.restore() } } }
